name: hypertube-nodejs-sdk
description: Hypertube allows you to reference and use modules or packages written in (Java/Kotlin/Groovy/Clojure, C#/VB.NET, Ruby, Perl, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) like they were created in your technology. It works on Linux/Windows and MacOS for applications created in JVM, CLR/Netcore, Perl, Python, Ruby, NodeJS, C++ or GoLang and gives you unparalleled freedom and flexibility with native performance in building your mixed-technologies products. Let it be accessing best AI or cryptography libraries, devices SDKs, legacy client modules, internal custom packages or anything from public repositories available on NPM, Nuget, PyPI, Maven/Gradle, RubyGems or GitHub. Get free from programming languages barriers today! For more information check out our guides at https://www.hypertube.dev/guides/v2/
author: Graftcode S.A.

scripts.test: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/unit tests/functional --maxWorkers=3 --colors --coverage
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/unit --maxWorkers=3 --colors --coverage
scripts.test:functional: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/functional --maxWorkers=3 --colors --coverage
scripts.test:functionalStateless: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/functional -t="Functional_Stateless" --maxWorkers=3 --colors --coverage
scripts.webSocketClientTests: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/webSocketClientTests --maxWorkers=3 --colors
scripts.http2ClientTests: npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest tests/http2ClientTests --maxWorkers=3 --colors
scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types
